work.title: Testament of Adam
work.edition: Machine translation (gpt-6.1-sol, Patristica, 2026-10-28) of: Michael Kmosko Testamentum patris nostri Adam Patrologia Syriaca 1.2 Paris Firmin-Did; TEI by J. E. Walters, Digital Syriac Corpus (syriaccorpus.org 523)

paragraphs.text: The Testament of Our Father Adam

The first hour of the night: the thanksgiving of the demons. At that hour they do no wrong and do not harm people at all. The second hour: the thanksgiving of the doves. The third hour: the thanksgiving of the fish, the fire, and all the lower depths. The fourth hour: the proclamation of holiness by the seraphim. Before I sinned, I used to hear the sound of their wings in Paradise in this way: as the seraphim beat their wings to the sound of their proclamations of holiness. But since I transgressed the law, I have not heard that sound. The fifth hour: the thanksgiving of the waters above heaven. In this way, the angels and I used to hear the sound of the mighty waves, which a command urged on to give glory to the Creator. The sixth hour: the gathering of the clouds and the great fear that comes in the middle of the night. The seventh hour: the vision of the heavenly hosts. When the waters sleep. At that hour water is drawn, and God's priest mixes holy oil into it and anoints those who are afflicted, and they find relief. The eighth hour: the sprouting of the earth's plants, when dew descends from heaven. The ninth hour: the thanksgiving of the cherubim. The tenth hour: the thanksgiving of human beings. The gate of heaven opens, and the prayers of every living thing enter, bow down in worship, and depart. At that hour, whatever a person asks of God is given to them, when the wings of the seraphim and the roosters beat. The eleventh hour: joy throughout the earth, when the sun rises from Paradise and shines upon created things. The twelfth hour: the awaiting of incense and the silence imposed upon all the ranks of fire and spirit, until all the priests offer incense to the Godhead. Then all the heavenly hosts are released. The hours of the night are complete. Next, the hours of the day. The first hour of the day: the petition of the heavenly beings. The second hour: the prayer of the angels. The third hour: the thanksgiving of the birds. The fourth hour: the thanksgiving of the animals. The fifth hour: the thanksgiving of those above heaven. The sixth hour: the thanksgiving of the cherubim, who intercede concerning the wrongdoing of our humanity. The seventh hour: entrance and departure before God, as the prayers of every living thing enter, bow down in worship, and depart. The eighth hour: the thanksgiving of fire and water. The ninth hour: the supplication of the angels who stand before the throne of Majesty. The tenth hour: the visitation of the waters, when the Spirit descends and hovers over the waters and the springs. And if the Spirit of the Lord had descended and hovered over the waters and the springs, human beings would have been harmed. Everyone the demons saw, they would harm. At that hour water is drawn, and God's priest mixes holy oil into it and anoints those who are afflicted, and they are healed and made well. The eleventh hour: the delight and joy of the righteous. The twelfth hour, which is evening: the supplication of human beings for acceptance before God, the Lord of all. From the Book of Rays. From the First Testament of Our Father Adam. With the help of our Lord: the Testament of Our Father Adam, from God. He became mortally ill and called his son Seth and said to him, “My son, the one who formed me from dust instructed me and granted me the ability to give names to the animals of the earth and the birds of heaven. He also instructed me about the hours of the day and night and revealed to me what they are like.” The hours of the day. The first hour of the day: the petition of human beings. The second hour: the prayers of the angels. The third hour: the thanksgiving of the birds. The fourth hour: the thanksgiving of the crawling creatures. The fifth hour: the thanksgiving of all living creatures. The sixth hour: the petition of the cherubim, who intercede for our human race. The seventh hour: entrance and departure before God. The eighth hour: the thanksgiving of heaven and earth and the fiery beings. The ninth hour: the praise of God's angels, who stand before the throne of glory. The tenth hour: the waiting of the waters, when the Spirit descends and hovers over the springs. At that hour water is drawn. The priest mixes holy oil into it and anoints those who are afflicted and those who are tormented by evil spirits, and they are healed. The eleventh hour: the rejoicing and gladness of the righteous. The twelfth hour: the supplication of human beings for favor is accepted before God. The hours of the day are ended. Next, the hours of the night. The first hour: the thanksgiving of the demons. For during the hour of their thanksgivings they neither deceive nor do harm, until they are released from their thanksgivings. The second hour: the thanksgiving of the fish and everything that moves in the waters. The third hour: the thanksgiving of the dragons and all the depths of fire and those beneath the fire of the earth. The fourth hour: the proclamation of holiness by the seraphim. This is what I, Adam, used to hear in Paradise before I sinned. But after I sinned and transgressed the commandment, I no longer heard that sound, as the seraphim beat their wings to the sound of their proclamations of holiness. The fifth hour: the thanksgiving of the waters above heaven. This is how I and the angels used to hear, within Paradise, the lovely, mighty voices, as the signal urged them to give praise to the Lord their Creator. The sixth hour: the examination of the clouds and great fear at midnight. The seventh hour: The rest of the animals of the earth and of all created beings, when the waters sleep. At that hour water is drawn, and the priest mixes holy oil into it. He anoints with it those who cannot sleep, and they sleep and find rest. The eighth hour: thanksgiving for the sprouting of vegetation from the earth. The ninth hour: the thanksgiving of all the angels of heaven. Prayers enter before God when the wings of the seraphim beat and the rooster crows. The tenth hour: the gate of heaven opens so that prayers may enter and bow down in worship. Whatever anyone asks with a pure heart is given to them. The eleventh hour: the gladness of everything, when the sun rises over the Lord's Paradise and shines upon all creatures. The twelfth hour: waiting and great silence in heaven, with all the ranks of fire and spirit, when incense is offered to God. The end. Adam said to his son Seth: My son, I have heard that God will come into the world after a time. He will be conceived by a virgin, put on a body, and be born as a human being, and he will grow up like a child. He will perform signs and wonders on earth. He will walk on the waves of the sea. He will rebuke the winds, and they will grow still. He will give a signal to the waves of the sea. He will rebuke the winds, and they will grow still. He will give a signal to the waves, and they will stop. He will open the eyes of the blind. He will cleanse lepers. He will make the deaf hear. Those who stammer will speak. He will straighten those who are bent over. He will make the paralyzed move. Those who are lost he will find. He will drive away devils and cast out demons. For he said to me in Paradise, when I picked some of the fruit in which death was hidden: Adam, Adam, do not be afraid. You wanted to become God; I will make you God. But not now. Rather, after a long span of years, I will hand you over to death, and moths and worms will consume your body. I [?] and said to him, “Why, my Lord?” He said to me, “Because you listened to the serpent’s words, you and your children will become food for the serpent.” “After a short time, mercy came upon us, because you were created in my image, and I will not let you decay in Sheol.” “For your sake I will be born of the virgin Mary. For your sake I will taste death and enter the abode of the dead. For your sake I will make a new heaven.” “I will give your children authority over it. After I have been in the tomb for three days, I will raise the body that I put on from you.” “I will seat you at the right hand of my divinity. I will make you a god, as you desired. I will take from the gift and restore it to you and your children,” “which is the righteousness of heaven.” You have heard, my son Seth, that a flood will come and wash away the whole earth because of the daughters of your brother Cain. For out of jealousy over your sister Lebuda, he killed your brother Abel, since sins originated from your mother Eve. After the flood, the world will remain visible for six thousand years, and then its end will come. I, Seth, wrote this testament. My father died, and they buried him east of Paradise, opposite the first town built on earth, whose name was Enoch. The angels and the heavenly hosts accompanied Adam’s funeral procession, because he had been created in God’s image. The sun and moon grew dark, and there was darkness for seven days. We sealed the testament and placed it in the Cave of Treasures with the offerings that Adam brought out of Paradise: gold, myrrh, and frankincense. The royal sons, the Magi, will come, take them, and bring them to the Son of God in the cave at Bethlehem in Judah. The testament of our father Adam is finished. From the same testament. Listen to me, my son Seth: God will come, as he told me and made known to me. After a time he will be conceived in a virgin, put on our body, and be born as a human being. He will grow up like our sons and daughters and perform signs and wonders. He will walk on the waves of the sea as though on wooden planks. He will rebuke the winds, and they will become still; he will command the waves, and they will stop. He will open the eyes of the blind and cleanse lepers. He will make the deaf hear; those who stammer will speak. He will straighten those who are bent over, strengthen the paralyzed, heal the sick, bring back those who have gone astray, find the lost, drive away demons, and cast out evil spirits. He made this known to me in Paradise, when I picked the fruit in which death was hidden. He said to me, “Adam, do not be afraid.” “You wanted to become a god. I will make you a god, but not now—only after many years.” “For now, I will drive you out of Paradise and bring you down to a land of thorns. I will bend your back, and your knees will tremble from the old age that overtakes you.” “I will hand you over to death. Worms and maggots will eat your body, but after a little while my mercy will be revealed to you.” “I will come down to you. I will be conceived in your daughter and put on your body. For your sake, Adam, I will become a newborn child.” “For your sake, Adam, I will fast for forty days. For your sake, Adam, I will receive baptism.” “For your sake, Adam, I will go up on the cross. For your sake, Adam, I will endure humiliation. For your sake, Adam, I will be beaten with whips.” “For your sake, Adam, I will taste vinegar. For your sake, Adam, I will be fastened with nails. For your sake, Adam, I will be pierced with a spear. For your sake, Adam, those on high” “will be shaken. For your sake, Adam, I will darken the sun. For your sake, Adam, I will roll up the heavens. For your sake, Adam, I will throw the heavenly hosts into turmoil.” For your sake, Adam, I will open the grave. For your sake, Adam, I will fold up the earth. For your sake, Adam, I will make new heavens. For your sake, Adam, I will create a new earth. And [?], after the three days that I spend in the grave, I will raise to life the body that I put on from you. I will bring it up and place it at the right hand of my divinity, and I will make you a god, as you desired. You too, my son Seth, keep God's commandments and do not despise his words, because he is going to come and be seized by unjust and wicked people and be counted among evildoers. He will go up onto the cross, be killed, and be buried. He will raise to life the body that he put on from you and place it at the right hand. Listen to me, my son Seth, because a flood is coming and will wash the whole earth because of the household of Cain your brother, the evil man who killed his brother out of jealousy over his sister Lubia. After the flood there will be myriads of weeks of years until the end of the world, and the world's end will come, and the allotted periods will be completed. The banquets of created beings will cease, and at his signal fire will consume the earth, to cleanse the earth of the entire flood. Then the Lord of lords, who is coming, will walk upon it. After I, Seth, had written this, our father died, and all the angels accompanied him, because he had been created in God's image. My brothers and I buried him east of Paradise, opposite the town that had been built on the earth, whose name was Enoch. During the mourning for our father Adam, the sun and moon grew dark in the heavens for seven days. I, Seth, son of our father Adam, who was from God, sealed this testament and placed it in the Cave of Treasures, together with the offering that our father Adam brought out of God's Paradise. These are gold, myrrh, and frankincense. Look, the Magi, sons of kings, are coming. They will take these offerings and bring them to Bethlehem in Judea. David your father sang songs to you before you came, only-begotten God. For in his prophecy he sang to you about the gold of Ophir. And look, your song has come true in actual events. Look, gold, myrrh, and frankincense are piled before you, little child. Gold for your kingship, frankincense for your divine being, and myrrh for your burial. Again, from the Testament of Our Father Adam. The heavenly powers: what they are like, and what service and governance in this world each of their orders holds. Listen, my beloved: they are arranged in orders, one after another, beginning below and continuing up to those who bear our Lord Jesus Christ and escort him in honor. As for the lowest order of angels, this is the responsibility revealed to it by God: they watch over individual human beings, so that each human being in the world has one angel from this lowest order accompanying him to guard him. This is its service. As for the second order, which consists of the archangels: This is their service: under God's governance they have charge of everything in this creation, whether powers or livestock, birds, creeping creatures, or fish. To put it briefly and in sum, they show care for and govern everything in this creation except human beings. As for the third order, which consists of the rulers, this is its service: they stir the air so that clouds rise from the ends of the earth, according to the word of the prophet David, and rain falls upon the earth. It sets in motion all the changes in the air: sometimes bringing rain, sometimes [?], sometimes hail, sometimes dust, and sometimes blood. For it brings about these changes, and thunder and the fire of lightning belong to it. The fourth order, which is the Authorities, has this service: governing the heavenly lights—the sun, the moon, and the stars. The fifth order, which is the Powers, has this service: restraining the demons so that they do not destroy God's creation because of their envy toward human beings. For if the cursed nature of the demons were allowed to carry out its desires, they would overturn all creation in a single hour and moment. But divine power stands against them, for he has set a guard over them so that they cannot put their desires into action. The sixth order, which is the Dominions, has this service: they rule over kingdoms [?], and victory and defeat in battles are in their hands. That this is so is known from the case of the Assyrian king. When he advanced against Jerusalem, an angel came down and ravaged the wicked king's army, and one hundred and eighty-five thousand of them died at one time. Again, blessed Zechariah also saw an angel in the likeness of a man riding a red horse, standing among the shady trees. Behind him were white and red horses, with spears in their hands. Judas Maccabeus also saw an angel riding a red horse, fully equipped with golden armor. The army of wicked Antiochus saw him and fled before him. Whatever the outcome, whether victory or defeat, they bring it about at the command of the living God, who gives them orders at the time of battle. These last orders—the Thrones, Seraphim, and Cherubim—stand before the majesty of our Lord Jesus Christ and serve the throne of his glory, honoring it greatly with their [?]. The Cherubim carry and honor his throne and hold the seals. The Seraphim serve in our Lord's bedchamber. The Thrones guard the gate of the Holy of Holies. This, in truth, is the division of the services through which the angels govern this world. The writing of the Testament of our father Adam was completed through the strength of our Lord's help.
